name: mirage
text: The socket that is on is Novig's, and it keeps Novig's prices live (the engine's last scan read 6,316 Novig prices, all by that feed). The ages in your screenshot are different: they are how old the other books' quotes are (FanDuel, Pinnacle, Bovada and the rest), and all of them come from PropLine, which hands us its own stamp of 7-10 minutes. Nothing in the engine's socket list shows PropLine streaming right now. The sockets that are live are Kalshi and ParlayAPI; BoltOdds' lines socket is not live. So the fair odds are only as fresh as PropLine's last read. I have not yet checked why PropLine is not streaming or whether ParlayAPI could cover those books, and I have not changed anything. I will look at that next and write it up as a task.
